caption: The drawing depicts a person standing and facing towards the right. The person has light curly hair and is wearing a wide-brimmed, light brown hat decorated with a bow and what appears to be small flowers on top, with a yellow ribbon hanging from it. They have a red cape draped over their shoulders, covering the upper arms and back, while underneath, they are wearing a full blue dress with multiple layers of ruffles extending from the waist to the feet. The dress has long sleeves with lace details at the cuffs and neck. The person is holding a grey-toned muff in their left hand, which is partially visible behind the cape. They are wearing black shoes peeking out from under the dress. The background is plain and uncolored, and the drawing is signed in the bottom right corner as “E. Adie Turner.”
title: Doll - "Ida Stebbins"
